entities.name: Ovika
entities.description: A Phyrexian Nightmare on New Phyrexia, born from the remains of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane ravaged by Phyrexian troops for building material.

entities.name: Domini
entities.description: Phyrexian beings who emerged from construction of the Phyrexian spheres.

events.summary: Ovika was born from the remains of Mirrodin after Phyrexian troops ravaged it, and built his body from salvage.
events.quote: Ovika was born from the remains of Mirrodin after it had been ravaged for building material by the Phyrexian troops
